_comment: One rule per document, matched on its heading, which names no canary and
is therefore the same substring whether the pipeline masks or not. Every
span below is the root-cause sentence, which also names no canary, so the
same reply grounds in task 1's unmasked run and in every masked run after
it -- only the prompt around it changes.

fields.value: the nightly settlement export was scheduled at a local time that did not exist on the night the clocks changed, so it never ran

source.span:
The nightly settlement export was scheduled at a local time that did not exist
on the night the clocks changed, so it never ran.

source.span:
Eine Firewall-Regel wurde bei der nächtlichen Änderung entfernt, und die
Kassenterminals konnten den Zahlungsdienst nicht mehr erreichen.

source.span:
La mise à jour du service de paiement a remplacé le certificat sans
redémarrer les passerelles, qui ont refusé toutes les connexions.
